feelings.text: I just found out my grandmother passed away
We won the championship, I can't believe it!
so nervous about my presentation tomorrow
honestly just calm, slow Sunday morning
I'm furious, my landlord kept the whole deposit
in love, our first date went really well
I miss home, missing my family tonight
kind of bored, nothing much happening today
I saw the northern lights last night and I'm still in awe
I feel lonely even in a crowded room
hopeful, I think things are finally turning around
scared of what my test results will say
